source.title: Neural Encoding and Decoding at Scale

selected_primary: Original NEDS Table 1 and Table 10 joint neural encoding and behavioral decoding performance: all five encoding masks (all behavior, choice, block, wheel and whisker) and all four behavioral targets, on all 74 original pretraining sessions and all ten original held-out sessions using the original target-session 70/10/20 protocol. Preserve every one of the nine source endpoints and the applicable original author comparators; no mixed-unit scalar or convenient cohort subset.

target.description: Original NEDS Table 1 and Table 10 joint neural encoding and behavioral decoding performance: all five encoding masks (all behavior, choice, block, wheel and whisker) and all four behavioral targets, on all 74 original pretraining sessions and all ten original held-out sessions using the original target-session 70/10/20 protocol. Preserve every one of the nine source endpoints and the applicable original author comparators; no mixed-unit scalar or convenient cohort subset.

dataset.description: IBL repeated-site Neuropixels and behavioral recordings. Exact historical ONE object versions/checksums and processed arrays linked to the reported results remain unresolved; substituting a current download is not demonstrated parity.

cohort.description: Use all 74 pinned pretraining sessions and 10 pinned held-out sessions. The paper describes 73 pretraining animals plus 10 test animals, with two insertions from one training animal; authenticate the EID/probe/animal join before biological inference.

split.description: Original design fine-tunes each of the ten held-out sessions using 70% training trials, selects on 10% validation and scores 20% test. Preserve post-eligibility ordered rows, process-wide seed-42 random permutation history or captured MT19937 states, successful-session invocation order and literal floating-floor boundaries; authentic partitions remain unavailable. No session-wise reseeding, purging of original physical overlaps or new convenient split.

inputs.description: Encoding reveals only the declared all-behavior or single-behavior variables and hides every spike target; decoding reveals spikes and hides all four behaviors. Reward, target aliases, test-derived null rates and arbitrary auxiliary modalities are not candidate inputs.

preprocessing.description: 20-ms spike/behavior bins in stimulus-aligned [-0.5,1.5]-s windows. Paper excludes neurons below 2 Hz, while pinned prepare_data.py retains mean_fr>1/0.2 (>5 Hz). Original eligibility, validity-mask handling, behavior scaling and camera lineage require reconciliation rather than silent repair.

metric.description: Encoding: each neuron has [Poisson log likelihood(prediction)-log likelihood(evaluation-mean null)]/(total spikes*ln(2)). Choice/block use ordinary accuracy; wheel/whisker use un-clipped R2 across flattened test trials/time bins. Preserve source zero-rate/undefined-neuron behavior and audit its effects.

aggregation.description: Retain all five separate neuron-to-session encoding bits/spike reductions and four separate behavioral scores for each of ten original held-out sessions, then original session means and SEMs after the source animal join. Preserve author-applicable comparator incidence: RRR, NDT2 and POYO+ Table 10 decoding cells do not acquire invented neural-encoding outputs. Never average bits/spike, R2 and accuracy into one score; complete nine-endpoint joint decision remains unresolved.

original_numeric_anchors.role: Source-reported numerical anchors only; not authentic rerun or tolerance.

retained_previous_scope: Source Figure 2A same-architecture multitask versus unimodal training and Figure 2B multi-session versus single-session comparisons remain separately named biological/methodological reproduction obligations under the previous immutable contracts. The selected Table 1/Table 10 performance task does not establish those contrasts, isolate pretraining at equal model capacity, or reproduce every paper result.

predecessor.scope: The retained empirical IBL joint encoding/decoding comparative result: source Figure 2A multitask versus same-architecture unimodal training and source Figure 2B multi-session versus single-session performance, together with the already retained Table 1/Table 10 outcomes and original masks, cohorts, partitions and necessary controls. This does not add brain-region classification, monkey data or every separate masking ablation, and does not claim pretraining is causally isolated at fixed model capacity.
